They want to calculate from the available list's first airport to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024, business class ticket price. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get list of all airports. Then get first and last airport codes. Then get flight cost for travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date=2024-10-31, travel_class=business. Then we need to compute total payable amount. But we also need to consider booking ID 1234? Possibly we need to book flight for booking ID 1234? Actually booking ID 1234 might refer to an existing booking. We might need to cancel or modify? The user says "在預訂編號 1234 上儘快安排一個航班" meaning "arrange a flight as soon as possible on booking number 1234". That might mean they want to book a flight for that booking ID. But we don't have a function to modify booking. We can book a flight with book_flight. But we need card_id and access_token. We don't have those. We might need to authenticate first. But we don't have client_id, client_secret, etc. We can't do that. So maybe we just compute cost and provide estimate. The user didn't ask to actually book. They want to check different options.
